    world.declare_relation(
        "ownership_event",
        [
            Role("record", RoleType.REFERENT),
            rt("record_type"),
            rt("scope_ref"),
            rt("effective_start"),
            rt("effective_end"),
            rt("from_party"),
            rt("to_party"),
            rt("owner_after"),
            rt("holder_after"),
            rt("basis"),
        ],
        scope="WORLD",
        description="Title or custody event from the ownership export. Empty owner_after is recorded as written.",
    )

    for row in source.rows("evidence/ownership_records.csv"):
        record = f"ownership:{row['record_no']}"
        world.add_referent(record, label=row["record_no"])

            "ownership_event",

            origin=ConstructionOrigin.MECHANICAL,
            grounding=source.grounding(

After the mill accepted ticket **DR-44** on receiving slip **HFM-IN-601** (ownership record TR-106, 2025-09-05), **Hearthland Feed Mill** held title to the lot.

During the Redline haul to the mill (custody record TR-103, dispatch handoff **RL-8841**, 2025-09-04 through mill acceptance), **Redline Haulage** had custody of the lot while **Prairie Gate Elevator** retained title.

The handwritten note **`N3 / EF-18?`** on the **PGE-OUT-5003** route packet is a carrier cargo mark (manifest **NS-8910**), not a validated elevator scale ticket. **`N3`** is a route code used on route paperwork (the carrier manifest itself notes that N3 is a route code, not a confirmed scale ticket). **`EF-18?`** is an informal, question-marked guess that the truck might involve intake ticket **EF-18** (East Fork Co-op, received into North House 12 / B-12 on 2025-09-03).

**No — EF-18 cannot be treated as the established source ticket for that truck.** The loadout and bin records for PGE-OUT-5003 do not allocate the 12,000 kg to any inbound receipt: the hopper sheet says **"no ticket on hopper sheet"**, and operating notes state the handwritten note **is not a validated source ticket**. North House 12 held grain from multiple receipts (DR-44, WB-390, and EF-18), and earlier loadout PGE-OUT-5002 already drew a blended 26,000 kg from that bin without a per-ticket split. The note is at best an unresolved hint; the lab sample tied to it (SMP-UNLISTED) was recorded with **"source ticket not recorded"**.
